title: LayoutPublished v1
description: Catalog publishes an event: its layout and prices are frozen. Consumers fetch the layout with GET /api/v1/events/{eventId}/layout. Routing key: catalog.layout-published. Consumers ignore unknown fields (ADR-0009, part F).

eventId.description: ID of this message, used by consumers to recognize duplicates

correlationId.description: Correlation ID of the request that caused the message, or null when there was none

aggregateId.description: The ticketed event; the same as data.eventId

layoutVersion.description: The event version at publishing; the layout endpoint returns the same number
